Delhi: 56-Year-Old Arrested in Sexual Assault of Class 6 Girl

A 56-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the sexual assault of a Class 6 student in Delhi's Sadar Bazaar. The incident reportedly occurred inside a shop where the girl was allegedly tied up and assaulted. The victim is stated to be 10 years old.
